method.requests: Normal unauthenticated HTTPS GET requests; no access-control or network restriction bypass.
method.observation_limits: HTTP success verifies only the sampled response, not complete coverage, source accuracy, redistribution rights or point-in-time validity.

findings.observation: Historical snapshots end on 2026-08-18, before the 2026-10-02 study end. The newer 503-name snapshot adds BE, ILMN and P and removes BLDR, TAP and TTD relative to that last historical snapshot.
findings.impact: Carrying the old list forward misses a known change set; applying the new list backward introduces look-ahead. A commit date cannot supply an effective or announcement date.
findings.required_resolution: A verified initial security-level snapshot and complete changes through the study end, with effective and historical announcement/known-at timestamps.

findings.observation: The historical CSV exposes only date and ticker-list columns. No permanent security IDs, announcement timestamps or per-event primary evidence are present. The current snapshot is not an event ledger; a CIK identifies an issuer, not a share class.
findings.impact: Ticker changes, reused symbols and multiple share classes cannot be joined safely; announcement-time membership is unverified.
findings.required_resolution: Dated security-class identifiers/ticker mappings and source-backed effective and known-at membership intervals.

findings.observation: Yahoo share histories have timestamps but no historical availability or revision fields. The two Alphabet tickers return the same latest share count; separate classes in the original SEC filing have different counts. SEC facts and original class-dimensional filings are recoverable, but a complete vintage-aware class panel has not been constructed. Commercial sample requests require credentials.
findings.impact: Issuer-wide shares copied to individual classes would distort the square-root-cap weighting. Backfilling later reported shares introduces look-ahead.
findings.required_resolution: Historical class-level capitalization, or validated class shares plus prices, with observation times, known-at times, units, source/vintage and declared staleness treatment for every eligible security and signal.

findings.observation: The requested 2023-12-01 through 2026-10-02 Yahoo ANSS chart returns HTTP 404, while the SEC filing confirms its 2025 acquisition.
findings.impact: The public price route does not cover even this identified former constituent. Dropping unavailable names would introduce survivorship bias; a last quote is not merger proceeds.
findings.required_resolution: Complete raw executable opens/closes and split-adjusted signal prices for current and former constituents, with stable IDs, status flags and the required warmup.

findings.observation: SEC completion filings establish selected cash/stock consideration terms, but the complete ex-date/pay-date action ledger and actual settlement timing have not been acquired. The Nasdaq dividend endpoint is blocked at proxy CONNECT.
findings.impact: Ex-dates cannot be substituted for cash payment dates. Assumed merger proceeds or successor shares can change cash, reinvestment, holdings and subsequent trades.
findings.required_resolution: A complete security-level splits/dividends/mergers/delistings ledger with ex/effective, known-at and cash/stock settlement dates, actual final terms and supporting sources.

findings.observation: The current synthetic engine has not been accepted against all merger, spinoff and delisting settlement cases required by the original protocol.
findings.impact: Acquiring event records alone would not make the original experiment complete. Unsupported events must not be deleted or silently treated as market sales.
findings.required_resolution: Implement and independently reconcile the encountered real event types, then complete the full data and accounting acceptance gates.

minimum_missing_dataset.delivery: An authorized export or entitled feed is sufficient; no particular vendor or new purchase is required.
minimum_missing_dataset.membership: Complete security-class membership intervals and changes through 2026-10-02, verified initial snapshot, stable IDs/ticker history, effective and historically known-at timestamps.
minimum_missing_dataset.prices: Current and former constituents, raw executable opens/closes, separate signal-price adjustment provenance, trading/status flags, and all required sessions from 2023-12-01 through 2026-10-02.
minimum_missing_dataset.capitalization: Class-level historical shares/caps with units, observation and historical availability dates, revision/source provenance and validated staleness treatment at every signal.
minimum_missing_dataset.actions: Splits, dividends including ex/pay dates, mergers/delistings including successor securities, final consideration and settlement timing; records sufficient to resolve events relevant to the reporting end.
minimum_missing_dataset.validation: Matched benchmark conventions, verified exchange calendar, immutable file hashes, permitted use and independent event-ledger reconciliation. Data delivery alone does not satisfy engine acceptance.

separate_experiment_boundary: A real ETF pilot can answer a narrower question with different inputs. Its execution/results do not complete or substitute for the frozen original four-arm stock experiment.
